content: Mind Thief Book Sub-title or tag line. Dictate whether this is a series or not.  Doctor Julia Marcos is a brilliant scientist with a machine that could change the word, the ability to record life, not just a document of it, but the full sensory input of a human being giving you the ability to replay there experience , feeling every thought, touch, pain, smell and sight. But before its ready she tries it on herself, reliving experiences of others but soon realizes that even though she unplugs from the device the experience has changed her forever, she begins seeing things, hearing things, as he  mind  tries to digest others choices as her own.
